english translation text: AMBASSADOR OF HUSSAIN
I AM MUSLIM IBN AQIL, I AM THE AMBASSADOR OF HUSSAIN

arabic text: BAATIL KA KHAUF‑E‑HAQ SE KALEJA LARAZ UTHA
english translation text: FALSEHOOD TREMBLED BEFORE THE TRUTH WITH FEAR

arabic text: BAS EK SADA SE HAKIM‑E‑KOUFA LARAZ UTHA
english translation text: JUST ONE CALL SHOOK THE GOVERNOR OF KUFA
I AM THE FEELING OF TRUTH, THE CONSCIENCE OF HUSSAIN
I AM A LOVER OF ALI, A CAPTIVE OF HUSSAIN
CHOSEN BY ZAINAB, ADVISOR TO HUSSAIN

arabic text: PEHCHAAN LO MUJHKO, MAIN SAFEER‑E‑HUSSAIN HOON
english translation text: RECOGNISE ME—I AM THE ENVOY OF HUSSAIN

arabic text: MUSLIM‑E‑AQIL HOON MAIN, JAAN LE JAHAAN
english translation text: I AM MUSLIM IBN AQIL—KNOW, O WORLD

arabic text: ASHJA’UL ARAB KAHE ZAMEEN O AASMAN
english translation text: EARTH AND SKY CALL ME THE BRAVEST OF ARABS

arabic text: HASHMI VIRAASATON SE AZM HAI JAWAN
english translation text: MY RESOLVE IS YOUNG, BORN OF HASHIMI HERITAGE

arabic text: HAYDARI SHUJAA’ATEIN LAHU MEIN HAIN RAWAN 2
english translation text: HAYDARI VALOUR FLOWS IN MY BLOOD
I AM THE BULWARK OF TIME
I AM THE SPRING OF LIGHT
I AM THE CHARGE OF THE EARTH
THE PRIDE OF THE HEAVENS
I AM THE VERSE OF LOVE
THE TRUST OF LOYALTY
THE GRANT OF PRAYER
A LIFE LAID DOWN FOR THE KING

arabic text: AITEMAAD RAKHTA HAI ALI KA NOOR‑E‑AYN
english translation text: THE LIGHT OF ALI PLACES TRUST IN ME

arabic text: KI MUJHE IMAM NE SIPAARATON KI ZAYN
english translation text: THE IMAM HAS CLOTHED ME IN MISSIONS
THE KING OF EAST AND WEST’S PRAYER CROWNS MY HEAD

arabic text: MAIN AKELA ZAAT MEIN HOON, LASHKAR‑E‑HUSSAIN 2
english translation text: ALONE IN PERSON, YET AN ARMY OF HUSSAIN
A LEAP OF COURAGE
DEVOTION TO THE TRUTH
ECSTATIC WITH GUARDIANSHIP
I AM THE ORDER OF THE FAITH
THE VERY TRUST OF BEING
THE HAND THAT BREAKS EVERY FORT
WITHIN KUFA’S CONSCIENCE
I AM YAZID’S DEFEAT
THIS SERVANT SHALL DECLARE THE RIGHTEOUS FAITH

arabic text: SHEH KA SAATH DEGA JO FALAAH PAAYEGA
english translation text: WHOEVER SIDES WITH THE KING FINDS SALVATION

arabic text: JANG KAREGA MUJH SE JO MAAT KHAAYEGA
english translation text: WHOEVER WARS WITH ME MEETS DEFEAT

arabic text: TEGH SE MERI NA KOI BACH KE JAAYEGA 2
english translation text: NONE SHALL ESCAPE THE STROKE OF MY SWORD
I AM THE AGE OF REVOLUTION
THE BLOOM OF THE BLADE
THE DREAM OF TRIUMPHS
THE RECKONING OF BLOOD
THE BOOK OF KNOWLEDGE
PUNISHMENT UPON IGNORANCE

arabic text: HUSSAIN KI HASEEN SIFAARATON KA INTEKHAAB HOON
english translation text: THE BEAUTIFUL CHOICE FOR HUSSAIN’S MISSIONS

arabic text: AA RAHA HOON CHUM KAR QADAM IMAM KA
english translation text: I COME KISSING MY IMAM’S FOOTSTEPS

arabic text: HAATH MEIN BULAND HAI ALAM IMAM KA
english translation text: THE IMAM’S BANNER RAISED IN MY HAND

arabic text: LEKE AA RAHA HOON MAIN BHARAM IMAM KA
english translation text: I CARRY THE IMAM’S HONOUR

arabic text: KOUFIYON PATA HAI TUMKO GHAM IMAM KA 2
english translation text: KUFANS, YOU KNOW YOUR IMAM’S GRIEF
LIFE IS THIRST UNQUENCHED
WHEN IS THE DAY RESPECTED?
BLOODSHED IS COMMON TODAY
THE IMAM IS BESET BY TRIALS
THE PEOPLE HAVE FORSAKEN LOYALTY
THEY ARE SLAVES TO DESIRES
WHATEVER MY SPEECH MAY BE
IT IS HUSSAIN’S MESSAGE
IN THE IMAM’S ABSENCE, AWAIT LIKE THIS

arabic text: ILM PAR YAQEEN HO, AMAL PE AITBAAR
english translation text: BELIEVE IN KNOWLEDGE, TRUST IN DEEDS

arabic text: NAASIRAAN‑E‑HAQ KA PHIR SE HONA HAI SHUMAAR
english translation text: SUPPORTERS OF TRUTH SHALL BE COUNTED AGAIN

arabic text: MUNTAKHIB SAFEER HOGA KAUN AB KI BAAR 2
english translation text: WHO WILL BE THE CHOSEN ENVOY THIS TIME?
IF THERE IS FASTING AND PRAYER
HAJJ, KHUMS, AND ZAKAT

arabic text: AMR‑O‑NAHI KI DEEN‑E‑HAQ MEIN SAARI MUMKINAT
english translation text: ALL ENJOINING GOOD, FORBIDDING WRONG
LET IT BE ONLY HUSSAIN
FORGET YOUR OWN SELVES
ACT UPON KNOWLEDGE THUS

arabic text: TO KEH SAKEN HUM YEH BAAT
english translation text: SO WE MAY SAY THIS TRUTH

arabic text: MUSLIM‑E‑GHARIB NE KIYA HAI JAB KALAAM
english translation text: WHEN LONELY MUSLIM DELIVERED SPEECH
MAY THE IMAM’S VISIT BLESS ME AT DEATH

arabic text: KARBALA UTHI KIYA HAWAON PAR QAYAAM
english translation text: KARBALA ROSE, SETTLED ON THE WINDS

arabic text: DEKH KAR HUSSAIN, KEH DIYA HAI ASSALAM
english translation text: SEEING HUSSAIN, I OFFERED PEACE
PEACE BE UPON YOU, O ABA ABDILLAH
PEACE BE UPON YOU, O SON OF THE MESSENGER OF ALLAH

arabic text: CHUR‑CHUR JISM HAI, JIGAR HAI PAASH‑PAASH
english translation text: MY BODY IS SHATTERED, MY HEART SMASHED

arabic text: HAI KAHAN PISAR MERA, KAHAN KARUN TALAASH
english translation text: WHERE IS MY SON, WHERE DO I SEARCH?

arabic text: QATL KARKE LE CHALE HAIN MUJHKO MARD‑E‑GUMRAAH
english translation text: HAVING KILLED ME, EVILDOERS CARRY ME OFF

arabic text: MAUT KE BHI BAAD HAI SAFAR MEIN MERI LAASH
english translation text: EVEN AFTER DEATH MY CORPSE STILL JOURNEYS

arabic text: NAZIM AUR RAZI KI TARZ SAB SE HAI JUDA
english translation text: NAZIM AND RAZI’S STYLE IS UNIQUE

arabic text: JAFFAR AUR BAKHSH BHAI AUR ALI ZIYA
english translation text: JAFFAR, BAKHSH BHAI, AND ALI ZIYA

arabic text: JAVEDAAN HAI LEHJA AB BHI SACH BHAI KA
english translation text: SACH BHAI’S TONE IS ETERNAL STILL

arabic text: HUM HAIN TIFL‑E‑MAKTAB AUR YEH ASAATZA 2
english translation text: WE ARE SCHOOLCHILDREN, THESE ARE MASTERS
THIS IS THE CARAVAN OF MOURNING
THIS IS THE PULL OF MELODY

arabic text: YEH LEHJA‑O‑KHAYAAL MEIN GHAM‑E‑HUSSAIN KI AZAAN
english translation text: THIS TONE ANNOUNCES HUSSAIN’S GRIEF
THIS IS THE TALE OF KARBALA
THE SHADE OF THE KING’S REMEMBRANCE

arabic text: AZIM HAI JO NAWHA‑KHWAN UNHI KA HOON MAIN TARJUMAN
english translation text: I AM SPOKESMAN FOR THOSE GREAT LAMENT‑RECITERS

arabic text: RIZWAAN FARHAAN SAB HI HAIN NAWHA‑GAR
english translation text: RIZWAAN, FARHAAN—ALL ELEGY SINGERS
NASIR, SHUJAH, AND ALI SAFDAR
SHADMAAN, SHAHID, AND NADEEM SARWAR

arabic text: SAB KE SAB KI EK HI SADA HAI YEH QAMAR 2
english translation text: ALL THEIR VOICES ARE ONE, O QAMAR

arabic text: MAIN HOON AZA KE PARCHAM PAR
english translation text: I STAND BENEATH MOURNING’S BANNER

arabic text: MAIN HOON DILON KE ARSH PAR
english translation text: UPON THE THRONE OF HEARTS
I RECITE LAMENTATIONS IN GATHERINGS

arabic text: MAJLIS AUR JULUS MEIN HOON JALWA‑GAR
english translation text: IN ASSEMBLIES AND PROCESSIONS I APPEAR
STREET TO STREET, CITY TO CITY
I AM THE COMPANION OF TEARS

arabic text: MAIN POORI KAAINAAT MEIN HUSSAIN KA PAYAAMBAR
english translation text: THROUGHOUT CREATION I AM HUSSAIN’S MESSENGER
